title: Strip no-valid-clock hedging from all impls
description: Remove dual code paths for clockless operation. GNSS time is the steady-state assumption. The pre-GNSS-lock interval is transient startup, not a permanent configuration. Update: (1) Python time_provider and all callers of wall_clock_valid to treat true as default, (2) Rust firmware time provider and consumers, (3) C/Zephyr time provider. Remove conditional branches that skip expiry enforcement, omit timestamps, or fall back to sequence-only replay when clock is invalid. Retain the degraded-mode path only for the pre-lock boot interval. Spec: 09-packets-timing.md §14.6, 12-apps.md §18.1.1.
